name: UUE Holdings Berhad
overview: 今年公司没有在公告中披露任何业务板块的扩张、缩减、出售或新合约消息；公告主要为季度业绩、股份拆细/附加上市、股东大会及地址变更等事项。最新一季（2026-08-31）营收 75,000,000 令吉，净利润 11,042,000 令吉，同比增长 71.2%。
overview_en: During the year, the company did not disclose any expansion, reduction, disposal or new contract for its business segments in the announcements; announcements were mainly quarterly results, share subdivision/additional listing, general meetings and change of address. Latest quarter (2026-08-31) revenue was MYR 75,000,000 with net profit of MYR 11,042,000, up 71.2% year-on-year.
